extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from XML methods/results and figure captions without promoting contextual claims beyond their assay support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PSTO2 analogues act on Gram-positive bacterial membranes; Sytox Green assays support concentration-dependent membrane permeabilization for S. aureus and MRSA.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PSTO2, SR, SR2, SRD7, SR2D10 where tested
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level exact percentages were not digitized; claim is qualitative/concentration-trend bounded.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: For E. coli, NPN uptake data support outer membrane permeability effects, with modified peptides showing higher permeability than PSTO2.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PSTO2 and analogues tested in Figure 7
mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantitative curve values are figure-only and not digitized in the local packet.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LPS-binding assays support interaction with the Gram-negative outer-membrane LPS component in a dose-dependent manner.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PSTO2 and selected analogues in Figure 8
mechanism_claims.limitations: Bounded to LPS-binding context; not normalized into exact binding constants.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectroscopy supports alpha-helical conformations in membrane-mimetic 50% TFE/NH4Ac, providing structural support for membrane-interaction interpretation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structure evidence supports but does not by itself prove killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Galleria mellonella MRSA infection experiments support in vivo antimicrobial efficacy for PSTO2, SRD7, and SR2D10, but this is efficacy evidence rather than a direct molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Kept separate from direct membrane mechanism claims.
